subject: Error in curl::curl_fetch_memory: SSL connect error

messages.author: 728e67c4ac0f902f
messages.subject: Error in curl::curl_fetch_memory: SSL connect error
parts:
Hi all,

I have a peculiar issue.

I am building an app where the user logs into SalesForce and retrieves data. When i run this app via R-studio server it works fine and the app successfully is able to log in and retrieve data.

when the user tries it on the app deployed via shiny-server it fails and gives the following error in the log : Warning: Error in curl::curl_fetch_memory: SSL connect error.

The app uses the following libraries:
shiny
RForcecom
dplyr
readr
httr
DT

the below code is what is causing the error (presumingly). Not sure how i can provide a minimal example of a working app as one would need to have API access to a SalesForce instance.
 
  sfdcsession <- eventReactive(input$login, {
    rforcecom.login(
      username = input$userInput,
      password = input$passwordInput,
      loginURL = input$instance,
      apiVersion = "37.0"
    )
  })
